name: In'yaku ~Haitoku no Kojin Jugyou~
source: The protagonist has a pretty normal life living with just his sister. He's the sole member of the chemistry club. One day, he finds a notebook with a formula for an aphrodisiac written in it. He starts doing experiments on various girls...
translation: 主人公和妹妹一起过着相当普通的生活。他是化学社唯一的成员。某天，他发现了一本写有催情药配方的笔记本。他开始在各种女孩身上进行实验……
